answer: Before an agent may quote a policy, the state insurance department binds the National Producer Number to one resident license, one carrier appointment and one errors and omissions policy, and a second seat reusing that number is refused at intake. A duplicate number trips license revocation, voids every appointment and rescinds the cover, leaving the clone uninsured. A license costs 120, the appointment filing 35 and the policy 900, so N fakes cost N x 1055 and each still needs a licensed human to sign. A ferrous sign above the river office and a summit photo change nothing.
